# Zeplynk

> Zeplynk is a Nigerian tech solutions and education company based in Kaduna, Nigeria. It provides web engineering, AI automation, and software services, and operates Zeplynk Academy, a developer training program for Nigerian professionals.

Zeplynk works with businesses across Nigeria and Africa to build scalable web platforms, automate operations with AI, and train the next generation of developers through Zeplynk Academy.

## Company

- Website: https://zeplynk.com
- Founder & CEO: Nash Ezekiel Pam
- Location: Kaduna, Nigeria (serving Kaduna, Jos, Abuja, Lagos, and across Africa)
- Email: hello@zeplynk.com
- Phone: +234-806-726-3891

## Services

- [Web Engineering](https://zeplynk.com/web): Custom web application development using modern technologies.
- [AI Automation](https://zeplynk.com/ai): AI-powered workflow automation and intelligent systems.
- [Solutions](https://zeplynk.com/solutions): Full catalog of tech solutions, including mobile apps, backend/API, cloud & DevOps, UI/UX design, data & BI, cybersecurity, and enterprise digitization.
- [Zeplynk Academy](https://zeplynk.com/academy): Developer training and coding bootcamp programs (software engineering, AI & machine learning, data science).
